Maya — Tactile Transduction and Sensing Physics said about it: Plainly that means 1 mN threshold with grip to about 30 N, where the 0.1 gram-force about 1 mN claim from the Giving the Robot Fingerprints: XELA Robotics Shrinks Sensors for Tesollo Hand Integration (E2) and the less than 0.1 N to 100 N array range from the terryum/survey-robot-hand-tactile-sensor - book/en/ch02.md (E3) show the span is buildable with PCB (printed circuit board) electrodes, but parasitics will decide the limit.
Maya — Tactile Transduction and Sensing Physics said about it: Plainly capacitive is stable for static force but needs complex front ends and piezoelectric film, PVDF (polyvinylidene fluoride), sees only transients, per strengths and limits in the terryum/survey-robot-hand-tactile-sensor - book/en/ch02.md (E3), so thinner skin helps sensitivity but hurts spreading and noise.
